ext.handoff.context_nearly_full: [Auto-Handoff] Context is at about {pct}% (from actual API token usage), close to the auto-compaction point. ext.handoff.intent_detected: [Guardian:Handoff] Handoff intent detected. The Claude in the receiving session will not see this conversation. Run /memoryatoms-handoff:handoff to fill in the mandatory 6-section template; do not write the prompt by hand.
ext.handoff.stub_prepared: [Auto-Handoff] A compaction just happened. A handoff stub has been prepared at `{stub_path}` (objective blocks filled). Please **fill in the three `{todo}` blocks** (why / approach / decision basis) so it is self-sufficient across all six blocks, so the session that takes over can continue losslessly with `/continue`.
ext.handoff.summary_filled: [Auto-Handoff] A compaction just happened. The compaction summary has been filled into handoff stub `{stub_path}`; just confirm the next step and fill in `{todo}`, so the session that takes over can continue losslessly with `/continue`.
